Slime Express Privacy Policy

Effective November 23, 2026

You can play Slime Express without registering. High scores, stars, skins, missions, and settings are stored on your device by default. The Google Play and ONE store editions offer banner ads and optional rewarded ads. Google Play Games sign-in and online leaderboards are available only in the Google Play edition.

1. Personal Information Controller and Scope

TeamCP (the “Developer”) applies this policy to the processing of personal information in the Android app Slime Express. The package name for the Google Play edition is com.teamcp.slimeexpress, and the package name for the ONE store edition is com.teamcp.slimeexpress.onestore. Each edition stores its game records separately on the device.

The app has no registration feature that directly asks for your name, email address, or phone number. It does not collect or retain your Google Account password. Starting with version 1.2.0, the ONE store edition includes the ONE store IAP SDK to sell the Remove Ads product (see Section 2.4). The app has no ONE store account linking feature and does not directly receive ONE store membership information or payment method details such as card or bank account information. ONE store’s policy applies to its processing of membership, installation, and download information.

2. Information We Process

2.1 Information Stored on Your Device

  • High score, stars you have, and skins you have unlocked or selected
  • Daily mission progress and records of rewards claimed
  • App settings such as audio and language, and the number of completed games

The app keeps this information in app-specific storage on your Android device to provide app features and restore saved records. It does not save your position or remaining time during a run, so relaunching the app does not resume that run. The app does not send play records to the Developer’s own game servers or to external analytics servers.

The app allows Android Auto Backup. Depending on the operating system, device, and your backup settings, app data may be backed up or restored when you reinstall the app. Backups provided by the operating system are subject to the backup service’s policies and settings.

2.2 Connecting to Google Play Games (Google Play Edition Only)

If you choose to connect to Google Play Games in the Google Play edition, Google may process your authentication status, player ID, and display name, and your high score may be submitted to the leaderboard. You can play single-player without connecting, and the app does not require sign-in at launch. The ONE store edition has no such feature and does not transmit Google Play Games authentication information, player information, or leaderboard scores.

  • Google Account authentication status and player ID
  • High score submitted to the leaderboard

2.3 How Ads Are Served (Both Google Play and ONE store Editions)

Unity LevelPlay mediates ads in both editions. Connected providers Unity Ads and ironSource Ads may serve banner ads and optional rewarded ads. The app requests banners for continuous display at the bottom of the game screen, so ad requests and related processing can occur before you choose to watch a rewarded ad. Banners may fail to appear depending on ad inventory or connection status. Watching rewarded ads for extra points is optional, and the app does not display an interstitial ad immediately after a game ends. Ad providers may process the following information to serve ads, limit ad frequency, measure performance, prevent abuse, and diagnose errors.

  • IP address, device model, operating system and app versions, language, and network connection information
  • Device identifiers such as advertising identifiers, where permitted by device settings and applicable law
  • Ad requests, impressions, clicks, whether an ad view was completed, and error and diagnostic information
  • Approximate location inferred from an IP address or similar information

The scope of processing may vary by region, Android privacy settings, and the policies of each ad provider. You can continue playing if an ad fails to load.

2.4 ONE store In-App Purchases (ONE store Edition Version 1.2.0 and Later)

The ONE store edition offers a Remove Ads product (product ID slime.remove_ads), a non-consumable purchase you keep after paying once. After purchase, the app stops requesting and displaying bottom banner ads. Optional rewarded ads for extra points remain available. This game has no interstitial ads. Select “Restore Purchases” in the shop with the same ONE store account to verify your purchase again.

ONE store Co., Ltd. processes payments and payment method information on the ONE store checkout screen. On your device, the app receives the following information from the ONE store IAP SDK to verify purchases.

  • Product ID, order number, purchase token, purchase status, acknowledgment status, purchase data, and signature

The app uses this information to verify the signature on the device and send a purchase acknowledgment to ONE store, then stores only the ID of the product you own in app-specific storage. It does not send purchase information to TeamCP servers. ONE store’s policies and applicable law govern retention of payment and refund records.

3. Purposes of Use

  • Saving game progress, settings, skins, missions, and high scores
  • Providing the Google Play Games leaderboard when you choose to use it in the Google Play edition
  • Serving banner and optional rewarded ads, measuring performance, and preventing abuse
  • Diagnosing service errors and maintaining security
  • Verifying and restoring purchases of the Remove Ads product in the ONE store edition

4. External Services and Information Processing

ServiceFeatures ProvidedRelated Policy
Google Play Games Optional sign-in and a high-score leaderboard in the Google Play edition only Google Privacy Policy
Unity LevelPlay / Unity Ads / ironSource Ads Mediation and delivery of banner and optional rewarded ads in both editions, ad measurement, and abuse prevention Unity Game Player and App User Privacy Policy
ONE store in-app purchases (ONE store IAP SDK) Payment, purchase verification, and restoration for the Remove Ads product starting with ONE store edition version 1.2.0 (ONE store Co., Ltd., Republic of Korea) ONE store Privacy Policy

External service providers may retain information or process it overseas in accordance with their own policies. Unity states that it may process information at its facilities and those of its service providers overseas, including in the United States and Israel. See the policies listed above for more details, including where processing takes place and how to exercise your rights. The Developer does not sell users’ personal information.

Detailed Notice of Overseas Transfers (Added November 23, 2026)

Under Articles 28-8 and 30 of the Personal Information Protection Act, this notice describes each activity in this game that involves transferring personal information overseas. The information below goes directly from your device to each provider without passing through TeamCP servers. Provider details come from the policies each provider has published.

Advertising (Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads, and ironSource Ads)

Recipient and contact details
Unity Technologies (Unity Technologies S.F.), operator of Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads, and ironSource Ads
Contact · DPO@unity3d.com · 116 New Montgomery Street, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94105, United States
Destination countries
The United States, countries where Unity has facilities (including Israel, where ironSource is headquartered), and countries with data centers operated by Unity’s service providers, such as Google Cloud Platform, as described in the Unity Game Player and App User Privacy Policy.
Information transferred
Advertising identifiers (such as the Google advertising ID and app set ID, as permitted by device settings), IP address and approximate location inferred from it, device model, operating system and app versions, language, network information, and information about ad requests, impressions, clicks, completed views, errors, and diagnostics. See the advertising section of this policy for details.
Timing and method
While the app is running, whenever the ad SDK initializes or an ad is requested, displayed, or measured, the user’s device sends the information directly to Unity’s servers over an encrypted internet connection.
Purpose of transfer
Ad mediation and delivery, impression frequency management, performance measurement, abuse prevention, and error diagnosis
Retention and use period
Unity states that it retains information for as long as needed for the purposes for which it is processed and may keep it longer to meet legal obligations or respond to disputes or investigations (Section 10, “Retention,” of Unity’s policy). Unity does not publish a fixed retention period for general advertising information, so this policy does not specify one.
Basis for transfer
Article 28-8(1)(3)(a) of the Personal Information Protection Act. The Developer considers this outsourced processing and storage necessary to perform the contract to provide the free, ad-supported game and discloses the transfer details in this policy.
How to refuse and what happens if you do
Turning off your internet connection stops ad requests and transfers. If you delete the advertising ID in Android Settings, that ID will not be sent. To avoid transfers entirely, you can stop using and uninstall the app, in which case ads and ad rewards will be unavailable. You can request access to or deletion of data already transferred by contacting Unity (DPO@unity3d.com) or using the ad’s privacy icon.

Google (Google Play Games and Android Auto Backup)

Recipient and contact details
Google LLC
Contact · googlekrsupport@google.com · Representative in Korea: Google Korea LLC (22nd Floor, 152 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul · 02-722-7778 · data-access-requests@google.com), as described in Google’s additional privacy information for residents of Korea.
Destination countries
Google data centers outside the Republic of Korea, including in the United States. To see where these data centers are located, visit the Google data center locations page.
Information transferred
Google Play Games (Google Play edition only). Google Account authentication status, player ID and display name, and high score submitted to the leaderboard.
Android Auto Backup. If backup is enabled on your device, Android sends this app’s saved data and settings to your Google Account’s backup storage. Turning off backup in device settings stops this transfer.
Timing and method
According to Google, when the relevant feature operates, information is sent to Google as it is collected over an encrypted network connection.
Purpose of transfer
Optional sign-in and high-score leaderboards, and device backup and restoration
Retention and use period
Google Account and Play Games data is kept until you delete it or for a period set by Google. See “Retaining your information” in the Google Privacy Policy.
Basis for transfer
Article 28-8(1)(3)(a) of the Personal Information Protection Act. The Developer considers this outsourced processing and storage necessary to provide the game integration features you choose to use and discloses the transfer details in this policy. Android Auto Backup depends on your device and Google Account backup settings.
How to refuse and what happens if you do
If you do not connect to Google Play Games, its data is not transferred. You can still play single-player, and the leaderboard is unavailable. The ONE store edition does not have this feature. You can turn off or delete backups in Android Settings → Google → Backup. In that case, your data will not be restored automatically when you reinstall the app or change devices.

The following processing takes place in the Republic of Korea and falls outside the scope of the overseas transfers described above.

  • ONE store in-app purchases (ONE store edition). ONE store Co., Ltd. (Republic of Korea) processes payments, and this game does not transfer payment information overseas.

5. Retention and Deletion

  • Information stored on your device. Clear app data for the relevant edition in Android Settings or uninstall the app to remove it from your device. Manage operating system backups separately in the backup service settings. If restoration is enabled, records may reappear after reinstallation.
  • Information stored by Google Play Games (Google Play edition only). You can manage this information using the Play Games data controls in your Google Account. Google’s retention policies apply.
  • Information processed by ad services. The retention and deletion policies of the relevant ad providers, such as Unity, apply. Unity says it retains information as long as needed to provide services, meet legal obligations, maintain security, and handle disputes. The Developer cannot set a uniform retention period for this information or delete it directly.

6. Your Choices and Rights

  • You can play single-player in the Google Play edition without connecting to Google Play Games. The ONE store edition does not have this connection feature.
  • Watching rewarded ads is optional. You can still play the base game without watching them.
  • You can control personalized ads in Android’s ad privacy and advertising ID settings. When a Unity ad displays a privacy icon, you can also use it to find personalized ad options and learn how to request access to or deletion of your information. Limiting personalized ads does not stop all ads, including banners.
  • Use the contact details below to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your information.

7. Children’s Privacy

Slime Express is not designed exclusively for children. The current target audience specified in the stores is ages 13 and up. The content age rating does not designate the app as a child-directed service. If the Developer learns that it directly collected a child’s personal information without the consent of their legal representative, it will take necessary steps, including deleting the relevant information.

8. Security Measures

The app keeps local data in Android app-specific storage. Google Play Games and ad services that require network transfers use their respective providers’ secure communication methods.

9. Changes to This Policy

When the information processed, external services, or app features change, we update this page and the effective date. We announce significant changes through the app, the store listing, or this page.

10. Contact

For privacy and app support inquiries, email teamcp.channel@gmail.com

For TeamCP’s general policy, see the TeamCP Privacy Policy

Additional Notice Under the Personal Information Protection Act (Added November 23, 2026)

Under Article 30 of the Personal Information Protection Act and Article 31 of its Enforcement Decree, this notice explains users’ rights and how to exercise them, how the policy applies to children under 14 and their legal representatives, the safeguards in place, and who serves as the Privacy Officer. It applies together with the rest of this policy.

Data Subject Rights and How to Exercise Them

  • You may at any time request access to, correction or deletion of, or suspension of the processing of your personal information that TeamCP processes. You may also withdraw consent (Articles 35 to 37 of the Personal Information Protection Act).
  • To submit a request, email the contact below (teamcp.channel@gmail.com) with the app name and details of your request. Since the app does not have accounts, include information that can help TeamCP locate the records, such as the approximate date you submitted a bug report or its reference number. A legal representative or authorized agent may also submit a request. In that case, TeamCP may ask for proof of their authority to act for you.
  • TeamCP will tell you the outcome within 10 days of receiving the request. If the law allows TeamCP to restrict or deny the request, or if TeamCP cannot handle it within that period, it will explain why and tell you how to object.
  • TeamCP does not retain information stored only on your device, such as app records and settings. You can delete it yourself using the app’s deletion feature, clearing app storage in Android Settings, or uninstalling the app.
  • For information handled by external providers such as ad providers or Google, you can also submit requests using the providers’ contact details in the overseas transfer notice above.
  • If your rights or interests have been infringed, you can request dispute mediation or advice from the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (1833-6972, www.kopico.go.kr), the Personal Information Infringement Report Center (118, privacy.kisa.or.kr), the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office (1301, www.spo.go.kr), or the Korean National Police Agency (182, ecrm.police.go.kr).

Children Under 14 and Their Legal Representatives

  • Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act requires consent from a legal representative when consent is the basis for processing personal information of a child under 14 (Article 22-2).
  • The app does not ask for a date of birth or age and has no features to verify age or the consent of a legal representative. The app processes information the same way regardless of age, so the same processing described in this policy applies to users under 14.
  • You can control personalized ads through Android’s ad privacy and advertising ID settings. Users under 14 should work with a parent or guardian to delete the advertising ID in Android Settings so that it cannot be used for personalized ads.
  • If you are under 14, please leave personal information such as your name or contact details out of bug reports and inquiries.
  • A legal representative may request access to, correction or deletion of, or suspension of the processing of a child’s personal information, and may withdraw consent. The process and response period are the same as those described above under “Data Subject Rights and How to Exercise Them.” TeamCP requests only the minimum information needed to verify guardianship and deletes it after verification.
  • If TeamCP learns that a child under 14’s personal information was processed without the consent of their legal representative, TeamCP will promptly delete any of that information it holds.

Safeguards for Personal Information

  • Android keeps app records and settings in storage isolated for each app. The app sends this information to TeamCP servers only in the cases described in this policy.
  • The app encrypts information it sends over the internet, including ad requests and Google service integration data, using HTTPS/TLS.
  • TeamCP minimizes the personal information it holds by offering no registration and collecting no passwords, names, or phone numbers.
  • TeamCP has no servers that receive game records. Information on the device stays there until you delete it.
  • TeamCP keeps inquiry emails no longer than necessary after responding, then deletes them. TeamCP retains personal information only in electronic files and deletes them at the end of the retention period.
  • The safeguards for information handled by external providers such as ad providers or Google are governed by those providers’ policies.
